_readme: The News page: the studio's LinkedIn posts, newest first on the page (order here does not matter). Each post links back to LinkedIn, where the whole post and its comments live. id is the number in the post's address, linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:<id>, and the date comes from it too, so there is no date to type. title is our headline for the post. excerpt is one or two short passages copied from the post exactly as posted (the site shows an extract, never a rewrite). details is optional: short facts for an event. people are slugs from team.json for anyone tagged who is on the site. For a picture, either set image to a name in data/images.json, or save the post's own image as source/news/<id>.jpg (or .png) and run tools/images.py: it is picked up by the id.
